verdict.rationale: Neon publishes a Management API reference and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) plus an LLM-addressed endpoint index with per-endpoint doc pages, which could support interactive exploration, but no evidence describes a 'try it now' console or runnable code examples embedded in the docs. Missing for 10: explicit interactive 'run this request' UI, live code sandboxes/snippets execution, and any independent confirmation of runnable examples in the API reference.
